## Overview

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| **Family / class** | CPUE and abundance indices → Joint index and trend analysis |
| **Method name** | JARA |
| **Short description** | Bayesian state-space model for trends: combines several noisy abundance indices with missing years into a joint index and estimates rates of decline. |
| **Main outputs** | Joint index with uncertainty, population trend and decline rates |
| **Typical use case** | Multiple noisy indices; missing years |

::: {.callout-tip}
## Basic entry
This page is populated with the information available so far. Full documentation will follow the pattern of the showcase entries ([FLicc](../methods/dynamic-pool/flicc.qmd), [cpueTargeting](../data-tools/cpuetargeting.qmd), [FishualizeR](../data-tools/fishualizer.qmd), [mmsyFM](../methods/multispecies/mmsyfm.qmd)). Use **Edit this page** (top right) or open a *New method entry* issue to contribute.
:::

Repository: [Henning-Winker/JARA](https://github.com/Henning-Winker/JARA). Builds joint indices from multiple noisy series (Conn 2009 approach) and estimates trends and decline rates; adopted by GFCM (SoMFi 2025) and JRC (STECF).
